g.text: generated from docs/gener8.ecore by npm run model-svg · ◆ contains · → refers to · ⇢ enum type · ▷ inherits · hover a class for its notes

g.title: Patch: Root of a GENER8 patch file (src/core/types.ts Patch). seed is a uint32. tempo is clamped to 20..300 by the edit path. Version 2 adds XY fields; a version 1 patch (fixed y = pitch, x = pan) is migrated on load by adding the stage XYField that reproduces that mapping.

PatchInfo: Who made a patch and what it is (src/core/types.ts PatchInfo), shown when the patch is opened. Every field is optional and plain text, trimmed and cut on load (cleanInfo): title and artist to 80 characters, genre to 40, url to 200, notes to 2000. Only notes keeps line breaks. Never affects the sound.
Key: root is a pitch class 0 to 11.

SceneObject: Anything on the canvas. layer is processing order, ties broken by id. The JSON kind and type pair is the class. x and y have no fixed meaning: XY fields map position to pitch, pan and the rest. Positions are clamped to ±8000.

BounceMotion: Over the first half of the period it drops from height above home and bounces the given number of times (each reaching 0.45 of the last height, timed like free fall) until it touches down; the second half is the same in reverse, hopping back up to the top, so the cycle repeats without a jump.
PathPoint: JSON stores each point as a two element array [x, y].
PendulumMotion: Hangs from a pivot length above home and swings ±swing degrees, slowing at the ends.
LissajousMotion: x and y oscillate at a : b times per period, tracing a closed figure (1:2 is a figure eight).
SpiralMotion: Winds out to radius and back in, turns times each way, once per period.
RoseMotion: A rose curve r = size · cos(kθ) with the given number of petals, passing through home between each.
SpirographMotion: A hypotrochoid: a circle rolling inside one of radius, drawing lobes loops; arm is how far out the pen sits.
HopMotion: Jumps between spots seeded points within distance, one hop every everyBeats, gliding over the first fifth of each step. Never the same spot twice running.
SpringMotion: Once per period it is flicked out stretch in a seeded direction and wobbles back to rest; damping sets how fast it settles.
ShuttleMotion: Back and forth along a line at angle, distance either side of home.

SpinMotion: Turns once every periodBeats, clockwise unless ccw. A spinning field carries its geometry round: members, maps axes and generator patterns rotate with it; a spinning sound turns its point and multi retriggers.
StretchMotion: Fields only: width grows by amount while height shrinks by the same factor, and back, every periodBeats.
Field: Fields act on members inside their shape. Handle values are 0 to 1 and are flattened into attributes.
InsertFx: Processes each member sound's mono signal.
BusFx: Processes the zone's summed stereo send.

MapField: Maps the position of the sounds inside it to placement through one or more Axis children, stored in JSON under axes keyed by the axis name. Not a processing stage: read directly by the engine before generators run. A sound inside several takes each target from the highest layer that sets it; outside all of them it sits at MIDI 60, centre pan. Selected by its edge or label only.
XYField: Default shape: w=800 h=480. Default axes: x pan -1..1, y pitch 48..84. Has no handles. Edges are inclusive. Breathing scales the mapping with the shape.
RadialField: Circle with one axis, r, from the centre (min) out to the edge (max): a spotlight. Default shape: r=240. Default axis: level 0 dB at the centre to -24 dB at the edge.
SweepField: Circle with one axis, t, going round clockwise from straight up (min) back to straight up (max); pairs with orbit motion. Default shape: r=240. Default axis: pitch 48..72.

TriField: Equilateral triangle stored as a Circle: r is the circumradius, corner a straight up, then b and c clockwise. Each axis runs from the edge opposite its corner (min) to the corner (max), as barycentric weights, so the three always blend (at the centre each is a third of the way). Default shape: r=260. Default axes: a pitch 48..84, b pan 0..1, c reach 0..12.

SpiralField: Circle with one axis, t, along a spiral wound out from the centre in three turns (centre min, edge max): angle gives the place within a turn, distance which turn. Default shape: r=240. Default axis: t pitch 48..84.

TonnetzField: Rectangle tiled with the tonnetz: the axis n is the hex cell’s offset from the centre in semitones (fifths to the right, major thirds up-right), folded into −6..+6. Default shape: w=640 h=440. Default axis: n pitch 54..66.

CcField: Rectangle whose single axis v takes the value handle for every sound inside, wherever it sits. Incoming MIDI CC on controller cc moves value (as logged set edits). Default shape: w=400 h=300. Default axis: v level -24..0.

Axis: Linear map along one axis of a MapField from its low end (min) to its high end (max): XYField x left to right and y bottom to top, RadialField centre to edge, SweepField once round clockwise from up, TriField opposite edge to corner. min greater than max inverts it. Targets and legal ranges (the mapped value is clamped to these): pitch MIDI 24..96 (snapped to the key afterwards), pan -1..1, level dB -40..12, reach 0..24 (× size), angle 0..360, spread 0..360 (degrees), falloff 0..1 (these four override RippleSettings). param:<key> drives that sound parameter, normalised 0..1 over its range, on sounds that have it.
PulseField: Default shape: r=160.
DriftField: Default shape: r=170.
ArpField: Default shape: r=170.
RainField: Default shape: r=180.
StrumField: Default shape: r=160.
GridField: Default shape: w=240 h=168.
PhaseField: Default shape: r=180.
ChordsField: Default shape: r=180.
TuringField: Default shape: r=170.
TopoField: Default shape: w=260 h=260.
PlinkoField: Default shape: w=240 h=300.
WaveField: Default shape: w=320 h=180.
BounceField: Default shape: r=150.
PolyrhythmField: Default shape: r=170.
SequencerField: Plays its seq: a scale degree per step from each sound’s own note (−7 to 7), or null for a rest. Each sound starts at the step its angle points to. Default shape: r=160.
LsystemField: Grows a melody (or rhythm) by rewriting a grammar rule for the given number of generations, played in 8ths. Default shape: r=170.
BellsField: Change ringing: the sounds inside are bells numbered clockwise from the top; each change rings every bell once, the method deciding how the order moves on. Default shape: r=180.
AutomatonField: An elementary 1D cellular automaton; a sound fires when its column is lit in each new row. Default shape: w=288 h=168.
PendulumField: A frictionless double pendulum hung from the centre; a sound fires when the lower bob sweeps past its angle. Default shape: r=180.
FlockField: Boids wheeling round inside the field; a sound fires when a boid flies into it. Default shape: r=200.
MidiField: Plays incoming MIDI notes (logged as midi edits) at their own pitch on every sound inside. Default shape: r=170.
ProbabilityField: Default shape: r=120.
TransposeField: Default shape: r=120.
QuantiseField: Default shape: r=130.
HarmonyField: Default shape: r=120.
HumaniseField: Default shape: r=130.
HoldField: Default shape: r=130.
RatchetField: Default shape: r=110.
EveryNthField: Default shape: r=110.
CanonField: Default shape: r=130.
MirrorField: Default shape: r=130.
SwingField: Pushes off-beats late, never earlier. Default shape: r=130.
AccentField: Louder on every Nth 16th, softer elsewhere. Default shape: r=120.
ThrottleField: Each sound keeps max notes per window; extra notes are dropped with a chance of depth. Default shape: r=130.
ScatterField: Moves a share of notes by whole octaves. Default shape: r=130.
SmoothField: Folds or squeezes leaps wider than max leap from the sound’s previous note. Default shape: r=130.
GlideField: A share of notes slide in from the sound’s previous note (NoteEvent glide). Default shape: r=130.
EchoField: Each note repeats at the same pitch, fading by decay each time. Default shape: r=130.
RetrogradeField: Each window plays backwards in the next. Default shape: r=130.
FilterField: Default shape: r=140.
TapeField: Default shape: r=160.
DelayField: Default shape: r=160.
ChorusField: Default shape: r=170.
ReverbField: Default shape: r=220.
ShimmerField: Default shape: r=230.
ResonatorField: Default shape: r=150.
FreezeField: Default shape: r=190.
TremoloField: Default shape: r=140.
LofiField: Default shape: r=140.
DriveField: Waveshaper from soft saturation to a wavefolder, at 2×. Default shape: r=140.
WaxField: Worn vinyl: crackle and wear. Default shape: r=160.
PhaserField: Six allpass stages swept by a beat-locked LFO. Default shape: r=140.
FlangerField: A short swept delay with feedback, beat-locked. Default shape: r=140.
RingmodField: Multiplied by a sine at the key root times ratio. Default shape: r=140.
OctaverField: A flip-flop octave divider under the dry sound. Default shape: r=140.
SpringField: A two-spring reverb tank. Default shape: r=200.
BeatRepeatField: Beat-locked stutter of the last slice. Default shape: r=140.
Sound: size is the diameter on screen and sets level (48 is 0 dB) and, with ripple reach, how far its retriggers travel.

RippleSettings: How a sound retriggers listeners when it plays (event sounds only, up to chain depth 4). Every attribute is optional in JSON and falls back to its default. Retriggers travel at 240 units a beat and lose strength by falloff.
MidiOut: Set from the mixer: the sound’s notes also go to the MIDI output on channel (1 to 16). With only, its own audio is silenced.
EventSound: Triggered by note events.
SustainedSound: Plays continuously and is shaped by the pitch and chord of its zone.

MacroSound: Eight synthesis models (model: vowel, chords, swarm, fold, grain, particle, modal, string) behind the same harmonics, timbre and morph controls, through a low-pass gate (decay, colour). After Mutable Instruments Plaits.
BassSound: Monophonic: a new note glides from the last. Saw to square plus a sub sine, a resonant lowpass with its own envelope, and drive.
